## CDW to Participate in the UBS Global Technology and AI Conference


November 17, 2026


VERNON HILLS, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


CDW Corporation (Nasdaq: CDW) today announced that Christine A. Leahy, chair and chief executive officer, and Albert J. Miralles, chief financial officer and executive vice president, enterprise business operations, CDW, will participate in a question and answer session at the UBS Global Technology and AI Conference to be held in Scottsdale, Arizona on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 11:55 a.m. CT/ 10:55 a.m. MT. The presentation will be webcast live on[investor.CDW.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.cdw.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54642162&newsitemid=20261117294726&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.CDW.com&index=1&md5=3ff35e29d67a7d79c0f09003f6e1f4d5) . An archived copy of the webcast will be available on the same website for 180 days following the completion of the event.


**About CDW**


CDW Corporation (Nasdaq: CDW) is the strategic end-to-end technology partner that cuts through complexity to turn customer ambition into outcomes. Working with organizations across the business, government, education and healthcare sectors in the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada, CDW enables organizations to navigate an increasingly complex technology market and turn their technology investments into lasting value. For more information about CDW, please visit[CDW.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2FCDW.com&esheet=54642162&newsitemid=20261117294726&lan=en-US&anchor=CDW.com&index=2&md5=3102a5435119425115cf568948108a4c) .
